meta.title: Create your wedding website
noscript: The website guide needs JavaScript. Please turn it on in your browser and reload the page.
localized.otherHint: If you leave it empty, guests will see the text in the main language of the website.

errors.summary.one: Please fix one field before you continue.
errors.summary.other: Please fix {count} fields before you continue.

step.names.name: Names and language
step.names.title: Who is getting married?
step.names.intro: Write the names the way you want them on the website, and choose the language.
step.date.name: Date and address
step.date.title: When and where will guests find your website?
step.date.intro: The wedding date and the website address. That is all we need to create the website.
step.template.name: Template and colours
step.template.title: Choose how your website looks
step.template.intro: You can change the template and colours at any time. The preview shows how the website looks.
step.program.name: Programme and venue
step.program.title: The day’s programme and venue
step.program.intro: Optional. Add what you do not know yet later, or skip this step.
step.info.name: Practical information
step.info.title: What guests should know
step.info.intro: Optional. Dress code, accommodation, transport and contact.
step.rsvp.name: RSVP
step.rsvp.title: How will guests confirm they are coming?
step.rsvp.intro: Optional. The deadline and the questions you will ask guests.
step.access.name: Access and privacy
step.access.title: Who can see the website?
step.access.intro: Optional. How the website is protected and whether you want a guest PIN.
step.review.name: Review
step.review.title: Check what you have entered
step.review.intro: Go through the summary. You can go back and edit every part.
step.finish.name: Save or publish
step.finish.title: Save or publish?
step.finish.intro: You can save a draft for yourself, or publish the website right away.
stepper.label: Guide progress
nav.skipRest: Skip the remaining steps and continue to saving
status.local: The draft is saved in this browser only.
status.incomplete: The draft will be saved to the server once steps 1 to 3 are complete. For now it is in this browser.
status.limited: Saving is limited for a moment. The draft stays in this browser and we will try again.
status.error: Saving to the server failed. The draft stays in this browser and we will try again.
status.storageOff: This browser does not keep the draft permanently (for example a private window). It stays until you close the page. To be sure you keep it, save it with your email.
names.first.label: First name
names.second.label: Second name
locales.hint: The website can be in Czech, in English, or in both. Choose at least one.
locales.default.hint: Text you do not translate into the other language is shown in this language.
date.label: Wedding date
date.first.label: First day of the wedding
date.hint: The website counts down the days to it and shows the programme on the day.
date.multiDay: The wedding lasts more than one day
date.last.label: Last day of the wedding
date.last.hint: After this day the website switches to thank-you mode.
slug.label: Website address
slug.hint: Lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens. We suggest it from your names.
slug.unavailable: This address is not available. Please try another one.
slug.limited: Address checks are limited right now. Try again in a moment; we also check availability when you save.
slug.error: We could not check availability right now. We will check it when you save.
slug.problem.too_short: The address must have at least 3 characters.
slug.problem.too_long: The address can have at most 63 characters.
slug.problem.format: Use only lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens. A hyphen cannot be at the start or the end, and two in a row are not allowed.
slug.reservationNote: Availability is only a guide. We actually reserve the address when you first save the draft, and we hold it for 30 days from your last edit. A published address is never given to anyone else.
slug.yearWarning: Careful: the address contains a year. Anyone who sees it on a printed announcement can tell the year of the wedding. Keep it if you do not mind; otherwise choose another one.
slug.conflict.legend: This address is already taken. Choose a variant.
slug.conflict.body: Everything you entered is still here, nothing was lost. Here are some available variants:
slug.variant.year: contains the year of the wedding
slug.variant.month: contains the year and month of the wedding
slug.variant.random: an unguessable variant with random characters
template.hint: The template sets the layout and the typeface. All of them have the same blocks.
template.editorial.description: Clean and elegant, with the focus on text.
template.eukalyptus.description: Soft greens and leaves, calm and natural.
template.chateau.description: Festive, with ornaments and a classic typeface.
template.modern.description: Bold colour and a strong typeface.
palette.contrastNote: All the colours on offer have a verified contrast, so the website is easy to read. A palette with low contrast could not be published.
ceremony.enableHint: The time and place of the ceremony are shown in the programme and in the venue section.
reception.enableHint: The celebration after the ceremony, with food and entertainment.
reception.sameVenue: The reception is at the same place as the ceremony
venue.name.label: Name of the place
venue.name.hint: For example Castle chapel. Fill in the name and the address together, or neither.
venue.address.label: Address of the place
venue.address.hint: The full address, so guests can find it in their navigation app.
venue.directions.label: How to get there (optional)
venue.directions.hint: Parking, the nearest stop, the walk.
map.enableHint: A map marking the venue appears below the venues, with links to Google Maps and Mapy.cz. The map comes from OpenStreetMap and loads through our website, so your guests’ browsers go nowhere else.
map.searching: Looking up the address on the map…
map.found: On the map: {place}. Check the location in the preview.
map.not_found: We could not find this address on the map. Try adding the street, house number and town.
map.limited: Map search is busy right now. We will try again when you edit the address.
map.error: The address could not be looked up. The website will be published without a map.
extra.hint: More items in the programme, for example a toast, the first dance or a buffet. All of them are on the wedding day.
extra.title: Title
extra.max: You can add at most {max} programme items.
dressCode.label: Dress code
dressCode.hint: For example formal wear, no white.
lodging.hint: Recommended accommodation for guests. You can add up to 3 options.
lodging.name: Name
lodging.urlHint: For example www.penzion.cz. We will add https://.
lodging.max: You can add at most {max} accommodation options.
transport.label: Transport and parking
transport.hint: How guests get there and where they can park.
contacts.hint: Who guests can call or write to. You can add up to 3 contacts.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.max: You can add at most {max} contacts.
rsvp.deadline.label: Confirm attendance by (optional)
rsvp.deadline.hint: After this day guests can no longer confirm. Without a date, confirming stays open until the wedding.
rsvp.questions.hint: We always ask for the name and whether they are coming.
rsvp.plusOne: A guest can bring a plus one
rsvp.dietHint: This is health data. We store it separately and delete it soon after the wedding.
rsvp.emailConfirmation: Send guests a confirmation by email
rsvp.emailConfirmationHint: The guest enters an email only for this message; we use it for nothing else.
rsvp.later: You add the guest list and the RSVP form in the website management. These settings can be changed.
access.noindex.title: The website does not appear in search engines
access.noindex.body: Only people you send the link or the QR code to will find your website. Search engines do not list it, and we never pass the link on by ourselves.
access.noindex.note: This applies to every website on se-vezmou.cz and cannot be turned off.
access.pin.title: Guest PIN
access.pin.body: Guests enter the PIN from the announcement to see details that are not public, for example the bank account for gifts. You add those in the website management. They see the rest of the website without the PIN.
access.pin.enable: Protect the sensitive parts of the website with a PIN
access.pin.enableHint: We show you the PIN after you publish, and you can print it on the announcement.
access.pin.label: Guest PIN
access.pin.hint: Digits, {min} to {max}. Avoid a run of numbers or the same digit repeated.
access.pin.storage: We keep the PIN in this browser only until you publish. After that the database holds only its encrypted fingerprint, so nobody can read it.
review.ok: Everything needed is filled in. The website can be published.
review.gaps.title: Some texts have no translation
review.gaps.body: The translation is missing in the other language of the website: {parts}. Guests there will see the text in the main language. You can still publish.
finish.accountNote: When you save for the first time, we will ask for your email and send you a code. You do not need a password.
finish.save.title: Save as a draft
finish.save.body: A draft is private. You can keep working on it and publish it whenever you like.
finish.save.point.private: Nobody sees it, and search engines will not find it.
finish.save.point.preview: You get a preview link nobody can guess. You can send it to anyone who should see the draft.
finish.save.point.reservation: Your address stays reserved for 30 days from your last edit.
finish.save.blocked: You can save once steps 1 to 3 are complete.
finish.publish.title: Publish the website
finish.publish.point.permanent: A published address is never given to another couple.
finish.publish.point.indexing: The website still does not appear in search engines. You give the link only to the people you choose.
finish.publish.point.edit: You can keep editing the texts and the look after publishing.

finish.publish.blocked.one: The website cannot be published yet: one thing needs fixing.
finish.publish.blocked.other: The website cannot be published yet: {count} things need fixing.

finish.error.generic: Something went wrong. Your draft is safe, please try again.
finish.error.taken: The address is already taken. Choose another one or one of the suggested variants. Your details are safe.
finish.error.invalid: The draft is not complete yet. Please fix the marked items.
finish.error.unauthorized: Your sign-in has expired. Save the draft again and we will ask for a code.
finish.error.limited: Please try again in a moment.
save.title: Save your draft
save.intro: Saving links the draft to your email. You do not need a password; we will send you a code. We reserve the website address once you verify your email.
save.email.label: Your email
save.email.hint: We will send a code to it, and you will sign in with it later.
save.backup.label: Backup email
save.backup.hint: In case you lose access to the first email. It must be a different one. We will send sign-in notices to it.
save.error.email: Enter a valid email, for example klara@example.com.
save.error.backup: Enter a valid backup email, for example matej@example.com.
save.error.same: The backup email must be different from your main email.
save.error.bot: We could not verify that you are not a robot. Reload the page and try again; if you use a content blocker, allow the Cloudflare check on this page.
save.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
save.code.title: Enter the code from the email
save.code.intro: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. The code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used only once.
save.code.label: Six-digit code
save.code.hint: You can paste the code from your clipboard. If you do not see the email, check your spam folder.
save.code.error.format: The code has six digits. Please check it.
save.code.error.invalid: The code does not match or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
save.code.error.expired: The verification has expired. Please ask for a new code.
save.code.error.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
previewLink.label: Preview link
previewLink.hint: A private link nobody can guess. Send it only to people who should see the draft.
previewLink.warning: You see the link only now: the database holds only its fingerprint. If you lose it, create a new one; the old one then stops working.
preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: This is how guests will see the website. It changes as soon as you edit something.
preview.banner: Preview of a private draft. Guests cannot see it.
done.title: Done, your website is live!
done.intro: Your website is published. You can send the address to guests, put it in the invitation, or print it on an announcement.
done.qr.title: QR code
done.qr.body: Guests scan it with their phone and your website opens. It is handy for the invitation and the announcement.
done.qrLabel: QR code with the website address {address}
done.pin.title: Guest PIN
done.pin.body: Write it down now or download the announcement: we cannot show the PIN again because we do not store it in a readable form. Guests enter it to see details that are not public.
done.share.title: Send to guests
done.share.body: Send the website address to your guests. We do not add the PIN to the message, it belongs with the invitation.
done.share.subject: Our wedding website
done.share.message: We would love you to join our wedding. You will find all the details on our website: {url}
done.pdf.title: Announcement to print
done.pdf.body: An A4 page with the website address, the QR code and the PIN, which you can print or enclose with the invitation.
done.pdf.note: The PDF is meant for printing. You will find the same details on this page.
issue.partner_required: Enter the name. The website cannot be created without the names.
issue.locales_required: Choose at least one language for the website.
issue.date_required: Enter the wedding date. The website counts down the days to it.
issue.date_invalid: This date does not exist. Enter it again, for example 19 June 2027.
issue.end_before_start: The last day of the wedding cannot be earlier than the first.
issue.slug_too_short: The address must have at least 3 characters.
issue.slug_too_long: The address can have at most 63 characters.
issue.slug_format: Use only lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens; a hyphen cannot be at the edge or doubled.
issue.slug_reserved: This address is not available. Please try another one.
issue.palette_contrast: These colours have low contrast and the website would be hard to read. Choose others.
issue.time_invalid: Enter the time as hours and minutes, for example 14:00.
issue.place_incomplete: Fill in both the name and the address of the place, or leave both empty.
issue.extra_title_required: Enter a title for the programme item.
issue.lodging_name_required: Enter the name of the accommodation, or remove it.
issue.url_invalid: Enter a valid web address, for example www.guesthouse.com.
issue.contact_name_required: Enter the name of the contact, or remove it.
issue.contact_email_invalid: Enter a valid email, for example klara@example.com.
issue.contact_phone_invalid: Enter the phone number in digits, for example +420 777 123 456.
issue.deadline_invalid: This date does not exist. Enter it again.
issue.deadline_after_start: The RSVP deadline must be on the wedding day at the latest.
issue.pin_required: Enter a PIN, or turn the PIN protection off.
issue.pin_format: The PIN must have 6 to 12 digits.
issue.pin_trivial: This PIN is too easy (a run of numbers or the same digit repeated). Choose another one.
